answer_1.quote: Semantic parsers map natural language utterances to executable programs.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate models using exact match accuracy, that is, whether the predicted query is identical to the gold query.

answer_4.quote: We perform a manual analysis of models' predictions on NL-SCHEMAORG compositional development set. We inspect 40 predictions of 8 models, and identify three major error types.
answer_4.guideline: Categorize errors into three types: Benign errors (semantically equivalent but different query), Linking errors (mismatch between utterance and query), and Structural errors (syntax errors). Also measure robustness to DB entity replacement.
